```mjs title=entry-a.mjs
import { rspackRequire, moduleFactories } from "./runtime.mjs";
moduleFactories.add({
"./consumer-a.cjs"
/*!************************!*\
  !*** ./consumer-a.cjs ***!
  \************************/
(__unused_rspack_module, exports) {
const first = require("external");
const second = require("external");
const viaModuleRequire = require("external");
const constructed = new require("external");
const { value } = require("external");

exports.first = first;
exports.second = second;
exports.viaModuleRequire = viaModuleRequire;
exports.constructed = constructed;
exports.destructured = value;
exports.method = (require("external").getValue)();
exports.named = require("external");
this.fromThis = require("external").value;


},
});
// ./entry-a.js
const consumer = rspackRequire(/*! ./consumer-a.cjs */ "./consumer-a.cjs");

process.__commonjsExternalValues.push(
	consumer.first,
	consumer.second,
	consumer.named,
	consumer.viaModuleRequire,
	consumer.constructed
);

if (
	consumer.method !== 42 ||
	consumer.fromThis !== 42 ||
	consumer.destructured !== 42
) {
	throw new Error("direct CommonJS external member access should preserve semantics");
}

const value = consumer.first.value;

export { value };

```

```mjs title=entry-b.mjs
import { rspackRequire, moduleFactories } from "./runtime.mjs";
moduleFactories.add({
"./consumer-b.cjs"
/*!************************!*\
  !*** ./consumer-b.cjs ***!
  \************************/
(module) {
module.exports = require("external");


},
});
// ./entry-b.js
const consumer = rspackRequire(/*! ./consumer-b.cjs */ "./consumer-b.cjs");

process.__commonjsExternalValues.push(consumer);

const value = consumer.value;

export { value };

```

```mjs title=runtime.mjs

var modules = {};
// The module cache
var moduleCache = {};
// The require function
function rspackRequire(moduleId) {
// Check if module is in cache
var cachedModule = moduleCache[moduleId];
if (cachedModule !== undefined) {
return cachedModule.exports;
}
// Create a new module (and put it into the cache)
var module = (moduleCache[moduleId] = {
exports: {}
});
// Execute the module function
modules[moduleId].call(module.exports, module, module.exports, rspackRequire);

// Return the exports of the module
return module.exports;
}
export { rspackRequire };
// expose the modules object (modules)
var moduleFactories = modules;
export { moduleFactories };

// rspack/runtime/esm_register_module
moduleFactories.add = function registerModules(modules) { Object.assign(moduleFactories, modules) }
;


```
